title: Umlindo kwiSango elivuthayo
intro: Isihlwele esithuleyo nesinamandla simi sijonge emnyango owoyikekayo, singaze sitye, sisele, okanye siphumle. Benziwe ngento engafaniyo nodongwe lomntu, balinde injongo enye eyoyikekayo—kwaye abazange bathobele nomyalelo omnye ovela eNkosini yabo.
clues: Singabantu abangafaniyo nabantu, abadalwe ngento engatyiyo, engaseliyo, okanye engadiniyo.
Inani lethu elichanekileyo liyaziwa kwaye lityhilwe eNcwadini—asingobantu abaninzi okanye abaninzi.
Asikaze simthobele uMdali wethu, kwaye asikaze sithethe ngaphambi kokuba siyalelwe.
Xa ifika imini, abangakholwayo baya kuqhutyelwa kuthi ngamaqela, size sibavulele amasango.
Siza kubabuza: 'Akufikanga na kuni abathunywa abavela kolu hlobo lwenu, benilumkisa ngale mini?'
Silinda indawo apho kungekho mphefumlo uphuma kuyo—indawo evuthayo yesohlwayo esingunaphakade.
